prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished but achievable low-poly 3D environment concept for Duck Rails, a modern abandoned nighttime VR horror-comedy game. Chunky Quackville-like geometry, visibly pixelated textures, simple angular trees, worn painted masonry and metal, no photorealism, no smooth Pixar surfaces, no characters. Landscape widescreen composition. The convenience store's FRONT WINDOWS AND MAIN DOOR MUST FACE THE RAILWAY: railway runs foreground to background along left side, store sits on right with front elevation parallel to railway and looks left toward tracks, gas forecourt between store and railway. Leave a broad clear pedestrian/boarding strip beside rails. Single modest 24x18m store; 2 pump islands / 4 pumps under a low gas canopy with emissive teal edge, canopy offset toward road so front door remains visible from train. Strong glowing pink QUACK MART fascia, separate tall teal GAS pylon with stylized glowing duck logo, warm shop windows show aisles/fridge silhouettes. Actual emitted light spilling onto nearby walls and pavement, restrained bloom. Cool midnight shadows and pools of warm light, enough visibility to see navigation and architecture; patches of damp pavement, not mirror gloss. A perpendicular two-lane road crosses tracks beyond the store; raised striped crossing gates and red crossing signal lenses. Across that ROAD sits a three-unit abandoned restaurant strip with individual glowing PIZZA, DINER and NOODLES signs; some letters unlit. Include side dumpster alley behind shop with service door and parked delivery van, parking spaces, broken curb planters with weeds, utility poles, clutter in small authored clusters, supporting trees/fences and abandoned lots extending along track approach and departure. Make it feel like a specific small roadside place, asymmetrical masses and distinct silhouettes rather than generic empty rectangular boxes. No HUD, annotations, watermark or diagram labels. No explosions, functioning traffic, huge city or extra railway spurs. Concept proposal only. CAMERA / IMAGE 1: Three-quarter elevated establishing view from above the railway approach, about 12m high, looking down track toward the crossing. Showcase the rail-facing shop windows and entrance, offset gas canopy, tall glowing pylon and restaurants across the crossing road all in a coherent composition. Propose a small abandoned drive-through car wash at the far right back of the forecourt, with its dark open tunnel visible and broken CAR WASH sign, adding a short alternate walking loop. The railway stays continuous and unobstructed on left foreground. Rich spatial depth, restrained atmospheric haze.

Readable routes and chunky pixel-textured detail, scary abandoned late-night atmosphere.
